content: समाप्तिः {%f.%} .²1 End, conclusion, completion, termination. .²2 Accomplishment, fulfilment, perfection. .²3 Reconciling or settling differences, making up quarrels. .²4 Perfection, development; नीते समाप्तिं नवचूतबाणे <ls>Ku. 3. 27</ls>. .²5 Dissolution (of the body); आ समाप्तेः शरीरस्य यस्तु शुश्रूषते गुरुम् <ls>Ms. 2. 244</ls>.
